description.value: Mountain Retreat Hotel & Suites is an 87-room full-service hotel in Squamish, BC, positioned on Progress Way near Highway 99 along the Sea to Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. The property features an indoor heated pool with waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre, an on-site restaurant and cocktail lounge (Timberwolf Restaurant and Lounge), and an attached Beer and Wine Store. It is dog-friendly and offers free parking including space for RVs, making it a comfortable and self-contained base for cyclists exploring the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Mountain Retreat Hotel & Suites provides detailed amenity listings across multiple subpages that serve as primary evidence. No mention of bike storage, bike tools, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific services appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. Wi-Fi (complimentary in-room and in public areas), laundry (laundromat on-site), vending machines (on two floors), nearby evening food (Timberwolf Restaurant & Lounge on-site), and an ATM are all explicitly confirmed on the amenities page; OSM internet_access=wlan/fee=no corroborates the Wi-Fi claim.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mountain Retreat' but the website consistently uses 'Mountain Retreat Hotel & Suites' — the OSM record appears to be missing the full business name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating 87-room hotel with an active and detailed website, confirmed address and contact details, and multiple amenities of practical value to touring cyclists.
